metadata.name: findback
metadata.description: SafeReturn — lost & found bounty escrow on Solana

instructions.name: attest_settlement
docs: Creates a permanent, non-transferable proof of a completed return and updates both
participants' reputation. The attestation PDA makes this permissionless but idempotent:
anyone may pay its rent, while the settled bounty and claim are the only source of truth.

instructions.name: create_bounty_sponsored
docs: Gasless onboarding variant. The owner still authorizes the bounty while a restricted
application sponsor pays only the account rent and transaction fee.

instructions.name: record_ai_review
docs: Records off-chain AI result (hash + score). Does NOT move tokens.

instructions.name: submit_claim_v2
docs: Creates a finder-scoped claim without locking the bounty to one finder.
Existing v1 bounty accounts remain readable and settle through their
original instructions; all new multi-claim clients use this instruction.

errors.msg: Funding would exceed the bounty reward

errors.name: InvalidClaimStatus

errors.msg: Legacy single-claim instruction is disabled for this bounty

fields.name: protocol_version
docs: 0/1 are legacy single-claim accounts; 2 uses finder-scoped ClaimV2 PDAs.
Existing accounts have zeroed padding here, so upgrades remain readable.
